cases.wire_note: One connection of the engine's signalling client (dialSignaling) to a listener on loopback: the handshake request as written (header lines in wire order), the commands sent in their order, and every client frame as it arrived. A frame of exactly frame_bound bytes goes out as one frame; one byte more is refused before any byte is written and still takes a sequence number. After the commands the listener sends the text ping, then the client closes: hangup carries the next sequence.

masked.\u003ckey\u003e: the handshake's Sec-WebSocket-Key: sixteen random bytes in base64
